thread:
Alex: Quick sync — PRD draft for the observability lifecycle playbook is up for review. Focus areas: dashboard onboarding flows, trace sampling UX, rollback/gating criteria, and launch acceptance. PTAL before tomorrow's roadmap sync. Draft: https://docs.internal/prd/obs-playbook (draft)
Maria: Skimmed it — two quick asks: 1) include a customer-facing error classification table, 2) what’s the minimal retention promise for self-serve? :thinking_face:
Josh: Clarify: retention tiers live in pricing doc, but for this PRD we should list acceptance criteria: perf targets (median dashboard load <200ms), error budget <0.5% in first 30d, and mapping of retention tiers to storage class.
Sam: Pushed a small update to the PRD — added "fallback to aggregated traces" option and a draft UX flow for the sampling toggle. Also added canary rollout steps for Dedicated and Hosted.
Anya: Edge-case: if a customer toggles sampling to 0 on a production service currently using live debug tracing, we need a support/SE override and an audit trail. Add an explicit audit-log requirement.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: PRD draft updated at 1765556000 by Sam — diff: +312 -28
Alex: Good call on audit logs. Also add: regression evals and prompt-based checks for any changes to trace enrichment. For launch checklist include: user docs, migration tooling, console CTA, SDK metrics and a migration runbook.
Maria: Customer ask from AcmeHealth: they want 90d retention for traces + logs. Is that feasible given our storage SLOs? @Josh
Josh: 90d across-the-board is expensive. Proposal: keep self-serve tiers at 7/30/90 but gate 90d behind enterprise contract + dedicated capacity. Will add cost modeling note and pricing pointer.
Sam: UX suggestion: onboarding tour that highlights the sampling slider and shows an estimated cost delta in-line. Put mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/obs-playbook-mock
Anya: Concrete acceptance bullets to add to PRD: 1) UI shows estimated cost delta within 5s of a sampling change, 2) migration preserves historical KV cache and does not reset trace continuity, 3) every sampling/config change generates an immutable audit event with actor and reason.
Alex: :thumbsup: This looks actionable. Can everyone drop their acceptance bullets and any missing edge cases into the PRD by EOD? I’ll consolidate and bring into roadmap sync tomorrow.
Maria: Adding mine now.
Josh: Adding cost numbers and the enterprise gating language.
Sam: I’ll attach the UX mocks and update the rollout steps with canary thresholds.
Anya: I’ll add the support override flow + a short playbook for incident responders.
Alex: Thanks — will merge once items are in. If anyone sees a hard blocker for launch criteria, flag here ASAP.
